item.title: Trump throws out power plant climate pollution rules
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency announced its plans today to kill any remaining standards on how much greenhouse gas pollution power plants are allowed to emit in the US. The move will only make electricity dirtier as AI, electric vehicles, and a revival of domestic manufacturing drive up power demand. The EPA's proposal today is a […]

item.description: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.

item.title: How to force quit on your Windows PC
item.description: If you're switching from a Mac or new to Windows, knowing how to 'force quit' an app can be confusing. Luckily, there are a number of ways to get the job done.

item.title: The human cost of making Big Tech accountable

item.title: Female athletes push back on Sydney Sweeney’s Novig ad for sexualizing women in sports
item.description: In a minute-long video, the ‘Euphoria’ actress and social media lightning rod promoted a prediction market platform ahead of football season. Sydney Sweeney is once again at the center of online controversy, with female athletes around the world speaking out against the actress’s latest project—an ad for sports trading app Novig.

item.description: The extension has since been updated to remove the OAuth exfil.

item.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro : double capteur 200 mégapixels et batterie 7 000 mAh dans les fuites
item.description: Une vidéo de coques diffusée par le leaker XimiTime dévoile le Xiaomi 18 Pro, attendu fin septembre avec un double capteur photo de 200 mégapixels, une puce Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro gravée en 2 nanomètres et une batterie d'au moins 7 000 mAh.
